bank_objective: Maximize equal-state weighted candidate acceptance coverage, subject to overall/contact empirical risk
selector_objective: Maximize predicted meaningful-improvement state coverage, then mean predicted gain, subject to overall/contact selected empirical risk and active coverage
constraints: Same global rule for all states; true contact labels used only for calibration/evaluation strata, never selection input
test_lock: These calibration files do not unlock test; strong optimizers and all primary contrasts must be frozen first.
